factual_claims.claim: Hepsor's 2025 performance weakened compared with 2024, reflecting fewer apartment handovers, lower project margins and higher marketing costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In 2025, the Group’s revenue and profitability were affected by a decrease in the number of apartments handed over to customers compared to the previous year – 141 apartments (2024: 194). Profitability was negatively impacted by lower profit margins of the development projects sold and an increase in marketing expenses. Marketing expenses amounted to 1,3 million euros in 2025 (2024: 0.9 million euros).

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated revenue for the fourth quarter of 2025 was 4.5 million euros (Q4 2024: 10.5 million euros) and the Group recorded a net loss of 0.5 million euros (Q4 2024: net profit of 1.0 million euros)

factual_claims.claim: The main operating factor was the reduction in apartments handed over, to 141 from 194, including 22 in the fourth quarter compared with 52 previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In 2025, we handed over 141 homes to customers (2024: 194 homes), including 22 homes in the fourth quarter (Q4 2024: 52 homes).

factual_claims.claim: The gross margin on sold projects also declined to 16.9% from 17.8%, while marketing expenses rose to €1.3 million from €0.9 million because more projects were offered for sale and required greater sales activity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profitability was negatively impacted by lower profit margins of the development projects sold and an increase in marketing expenses. Marketing expenses amounted to 1,3 million euros in 2025 (2024: 0.9 million euros). The increase in expenses was primarily driven by the growth in the number and scale of projects on sale, which led to more intensive sales and marketing activities.

factual_claims.claim: Conversely, primary sales agreements increased substantially to 185 homes worth €36.1 million, compared with 109 homes worth €19.8 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: During the reporting year, the Group concluded primary sales agreements for 185 homes under the law of obligations contracts or real rights contracts, with a total value of 36.1 million euros, which is nearly twice as much as in 2024 (109 homes and 19.8 million euros).

factual_claims.claim: Revenue generated in Latvia increased to €9.3 million from €5.9 million, partly offsetting the decline in Estonia, where revenue fell to €26.1 million from €32.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Sales revenue generated in Estonia totalled 26.1 million euros (2024: 32.5 million euros)... while sales revenue generated in Latvia amounted to 9.3 million euros (2024: 5.9 million euros)

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: As at 31 December 2025, the Group has a total of 33 active development projects in various development phases (31 December 2024: 24 projects) and 196,650 square metres of sellable area (31 December 2024: 172,500 square metres).

factual_claims.claim: Active projects increased to 33 from 24, with sellable area rising to approximately 196,650 square metres from 172,500 square metres.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: As at 31 December 2025, the Group has a total of 33 active development projects... and 196,650 square metres of sellable area (31 December 2024: 172,500 square metres).

factual_claims.claim: Homes under construction increased to 428 from 192, supported by four new project starts in Estonia and Latvia.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: As at 31 December 2025, the Group had 428 new homes under construction (31 December 2024: 192) representing a 223% increase compared with the corresponding period. In Latvia 227 (31 December 2024: 40) homes were under construction and in Estonia, 201 (31 December 2024: 152).

factual_claims.claim: The Group also expanded its Canadian portfolio and received building rights for the Weston Road project in Toronto.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In August 2025, a decision by the Toronto City Council came into effect, granting building rights for Hepsor’s first Weston Road development project.

factual_claims.claim: At year-end, total assets rose 3.4% to €91.8 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing liabilities declined to €47.7 million from €54.7 million, and the debt ratio improved to 52.0% from 61.6%.

factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Cash decreased to €3.8 million from €6.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
